arStrings.szText: Each time an enemy attacks you, the damage they take from {c_important}Payback{/c} is increased by {c_number}[{SF_15}*100|%x|]{/c}, up to {c_number}[{SF_15} * {SF_16} *100|%x|]{/c}.
{c_important}Payback{/c} echoes forward damaging a larger area.

Becoming Control Impaired or {c_important}{u}Injured{/u}{/c} while {c_important}Payback{/c} is on Cooldown makes it free to Cast and grants you {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} and {c_number}[SF_33*100|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction for {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} seconds. Can only occur once every {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Payback{/c} is also a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill that costs {c_number}[SF_5]{/c} Vigor, has no Cooldown, and deals {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_B}{/c} damage. 

When attacked, you have a {c_number}[{SF_9}*100|%|]{/c} chance to gain {c_number}[SF_5]{/c} Vigor instead.

{c_important}Payback{/c} becomes a {c_important}Centipede{/c} Skill that deals Poison damage.

{c_important}Payback{/c} smashes enemies in front of you, Poisoning them for {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_C_DOT}{/c} damage over {c_number}[{buffduration:UPGRADE_C_DOT}]{/c} seconds and increasing your Thorns by {c_number}[SF_27 * 100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}[SF_28]{/c} seconds.

Whenever you Crowd Control an enemy, reduce {c_important}Payback's{/c} Cooldown by {c_number}[{SF_26}|1|]{/c} |4second:seconds;.
